annotations.title: Tailor my résumé to a job

description: Tailor the candidate's résumé to one job with TrueInterview's résumé tailoring (the résumé alone; generate_application_documents adds the cover letter in the same call): bullets reworded toward what the posting asks, the posting's terms surfaced where their work shows them, nothing invented (every line stays traceable to their own résumé, and a deterministic check reports anything that slipped). Returns the tailored résumé, what changed, and a link to it as a PDF to upload. Their saved résumé is not changed. Give exactly one of job_id, application_id, or job_description with company and role (job pages are not fetched here: read the posting and pass its text). An AI model writes it (Anthropic's Claude, with DeepSeek through OpenRouter as the fallback). It uses the candidate's monthly writing allowance; writing_allowance says what is left. Show the candidate the changes before you use the file.

include_resume_file.description: Link the résumé as a PDF. Default true.

intensity.description: keywords: only surface the posting terms; rewrite (default): reword bullets toward the role.

job_description.description: The posting's text, for a job outside the catalog.

job_id.description: An id from search_jobs or recommend_jobs.

keywords.description: Terms from the posting the candidate wants on the résumé.
